ambiguities.text: The term 'invoker' is defined as a URI but the exact format and validation rules for the invoker string are not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume invoker is the origin URL of the dApp (e.g., 'https://example.com') following web origin conventions.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define how permissions are persisted or when they expire.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume permissions persist until explicitly revoked or wallet is reset; implementers may add expiration caveats.

ambiguities.text: The 'date' field in RequestedPermission is optional and its purpose is unclear - is it grant time or expiration time?
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'date' is the Unix timestamp when the permission was granted, used for auditing purposes.

ambiguities.text: The term 'caveat' is used without explicit enumeration of all valid caveat types.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume caveats are extensible and implementation-specific; 'requiredMethods' is one example shown.

implicit_assumptions.description: The wallet correctly identifies the invoker (dApp origin) without spoofing.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A malicious dApp could impersonate a trusted dApp and inherit its permissions, enabling unauthorized access.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot bypass the permission check by directly calling internal wallet methods.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Privilege escalation allowing attackers to execute restricted methods without user consent.

implicit_assumptions.description: The user interface for permission consent is not susceptible to clickjacking or UI redressing attacks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users could be tricked into approving permissions without understanding what they're granting.

implicit_assumptions.description: Permission prompts clearly display requested capabilities and caveats in a user-understandable way.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may grant permissions without understanding the security implications, leading to over-permissioning.

implicit_assumptions.description: The wallet's permission storage is protected from tampering by malicious extensions or local software.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could inject permissions without user consent, enabling unauthorized dApp access.
